title: Disney Treasure Formal Night ✨ | Our First Day at Sea
summary:
🛳️ **Our First Day at Sea on Disney Treasure | Formal Night & Ship Activities**

It’s our first full **day at sea aboard the Disney Treasure** during our Halloween on the High Seas sailing.

We start the morning with a run at sea (harder than it sounds!) before heading to Hero Zone to watch **The Incredibles Incredi-Course obstacle challenge**.

Throughout the day we explore more of the ship and take part in several fun Disney Cruise Line activities.

We learn to draw **Mickey Mouse in Skipper Society**, browse some unique steampunk Disney merchandise, and enjoy pizza while watching **Brave on Funnel Vision**.

In the afternoon we join a hilarious **interactive Jungle Cruise game in the Grand Hall** before testing our knowledge in the game show **Heard That?**

Later we get ready for one of the highlights of the cruise…

✨ **Formal Night on the Disney Treasure**

We take some rare formal photos, watch the Broadway-style stage show **Seas the Adventure**, and enjoy dinner at **1923 (Roy Disney side)**.

Another magical day onboard the Disney Treasure — and it’s only Day 3 of the cruise.

title: Boarding the Disney Treasure 🚢 | First Impressions of Disney’s New Cruise Ship
summary:
🚢 **Boarding the Disney Treasure | First Impressions of Disney’s New Cruise Ship**

It’s embarkation day!

After waking up at the **Hyatt Regency Orlando International Airport**, we grab breakfast at Starbucks before checking in with **Disney Cruise Line** for our sailing on the brand-new **Disney Treasure**.

Once our luggage is collected for delivery to the ship, we explore the hotel facilities before boarding our Disney Cruise Line bus to **Port Canaveral**.

Soon our boarding group is called and — in true Disney style — we are officially **announced onboard the Disney Treasure** for the very first time.

We then spend the afternoon exploring this incredible new ship.

⚓ Marceline Market for lunch
⚓ Sarabi event space
⚓ The onboard cinemas
⚓ Pool decks and adult areas
⚓ Hero Zone and kids club open houses
⚓ Our stateroom located right beside the bridge

After completing the mandatory muster drill we enjoy the **Sail Away Party** with Mickey, Minnie and the Fab Five.

The evening continues with a visit to the **Haunted Mansion Parlor**, entertainment in the **Walt Disney Theatre**, and our first dinner at **Plaza de Coco** featuring a Coco-themed dinner show.

This was our **first time boarding the Disney Treasure**, and it was an unforgettable start to our cruise.

title: Mickey’s Not-So-Scary Halloween Party 2025 🎃 | Travel Day to Orlando
summary:
Our Orlando Halloween adventure begins with a busy travel day from London to Florida!

After just four hours of sleep at the **Moxy Heathrow**, we head to the **Virgin Atlantic Upper Class Wing** for what might be the fastest airport check-in we’ve ever experienced — security and bag drop in under five minutes.

Before boarding, we relax in the **Virgin Atlantic Clubhouse Lounge** with showers, breakfast and a glass of champagne, then board **Jane Air (Airbus A330-900neo)** for our flight to Orlando in Upper Class.

After landing at **Orlando International Airport (MCO)**, we check into the **Hyatt Regency Orlando Airport**, where a small early check-in upgrade gives us a balcony room overlooking the runway.

But the real adventure begins later that evening…

We head to **Magic Kingdom for Mickey’s Not-So-Scary Halloween Party 2025!**

Despite arriving during a huge Florida downpour, we still manage to enjoy plenty of rides, trick-or-treating and Halloween atmosphere throughout the park.

Chris dresses as **Milo James Fetch**, while James becomes **Thackery Binx** (complete with black cat ears!).

After more than **22 hours awake**, we finish the night soaked, sugared-up and completely exhausted — but very excited for the rest of our Orlando adventure.

⚠️ Flashing images from fireworks appear near the end of this video.
tags: Mickey's Not So Scary Halloween Party

title: It’s Over… Our Disney Cruise Has Ended 😢
summary:
It’s the final day of our Disney Fantasy cruise… and we’re not ready to leave. 😢
After two unforgettable weeks at sea, it’s finally time to say goodbye to the Disney Fantasy.

In this final episode of our Disney Fantasy Transatlantic Cruise series, we arrive into Port Canaveral and experience Disney Cruise Line disembarkation day before making the most of our last few hours in Florida.

Disembarkation Day

We wake up early as the Disney Fantasy arrives in Port Canaveral.

After breakfast we return to the cabin to find a wonderful surprise waiting for us — a commemorative lithograph drawn by legendary Disney artist Don 'Ducky' Williams, who had been sailing with us during the cruise.

We decide to use express walk-off disembarkation, allowing us to leave the ship with our luggage instead of placing bags outside the cabin the night before.

From the port we board a Disney transfer bus heading to Orlando International Airport, where we say goodbye to our friend Justin after two weeks of cruise adventures.

One Last Disney Stop

With several hours before our flight home, we decide to squeeze in one final Disney visit.

After storing our luggage at the airport we take an Uber to Disney Springs.

Here we explore some shops, meet our friend Karen for lunch at Planet Hollywood, and visit the Disney Vacation Club lounge for the first time.

It turns out to be the perfect place to relax before heading back to the airport.

Flying Home

Eventually it’s time to return to the airport for our flight back to the UK with Virgin Atlantic.

After travelling in Premium Economy and landing back in London, James’ dad Paul kindly picks us up from Heathrow Airport, bringing our first ever transatlantic cruise adventure to an end.

What an incredible journey this has been — from Southampton to Spain, Madeira, across the Atlantic and finally the Bahamas.

Thank you so much to everyone who followed along with this series. 🚢

title: We Weren’t Meant To Stop Here… Castaway Cay?! 🏝️
summary:
We weren’t meant to stop here… but our Disney cruise took an unexpected turn. 🏝️

After the surprise announcement earlier in our cruise, the Disney Fantasy makes an unexpected stop at Castaway Cay, Disney Cruise Line’s beautiful private island in the Bahamas.=

As the Disney Fantasy sails into the harbour we get our first glimpse of the island — including festive Christmas decorations that instantly gave us **Disney's Animal Kingdom vibes.

Once ashore we head straight to the beach and rent a paddle boat to explore the crystal-clear water. It turns out to be a bit more of a workout than expected for James… but the views of the ship from the water are incredible.

Back on land we grab a drink and spot something exciting on the horizon — the brand new Disney Destiny, which would normally have been docked here. It’s a funny moment realising our cruise has effectively taken its place at Castaway Cay.

Next we rent bikes and explore the island, cycling:

🚴 Along the old runway
🚴 Up to the lookout tower
🚴 Past some of the most turquoise water we’ve ever seen

Lunch at the adults-only BBQ is a little busy (we forgot this cruise is mostly adults!) especially with some building work happening nearby. After grabbing dessert from the family BBQ and a quick stop in the island shop, it’s time to head back onboard.

Back on the ship we finally do something we’ve wanted to film for ages…

💦 The AquaDuck water coaster!

You’ll see the full POV ride as we race around the top deck of the Disney Fantasy.

As the ship sails away from Castaway Cay we take a quick break before meeting our friend Justin in the Skyline Lounge for a last-night drink.

Then it’s time for the final evening of entertainment.

First we head to the Walt Disney Theatre for Disney's Believe, before stumbling across a game show in the D Lounge called Mouseketeer Madness.

In a surprise twist… James gets picked to play — and wins! 🏅

We end the night with our final dinner in Royal Court before heading to the ship’s atrium for the emotional farewell show See Ya Real Soon.

It’s the perfect ending to an unforgettable transatlantic cruise.

title: Captain vs Cruise Director Cook-Off on Our Disney Cruise!
summary:
It’s the final sea day of our Disney Fantasy Transatlantic Cruise, and the ship is packed with special events before we finally arrive at Castaway Cay.

The day begins with the final episode of Good Morning Disney Fantasy in the D Lounge before joining Cruise Director Jimmy for his last Morning Mile Walk around the promenade deck.

Later we attend a fascinating Broadway Stars Series Q&A, followed by one of the most creative events of the cruise — the Disney Regatta Boat Building Championship, where guests compete to see whose homemade boat can actually float.

But the highlight of the afternoon is something we’ve never seen before on a Disney cruise…

🍳 Captain vs Cruise Director Cook-Off

The D Lounge is packed as the ship’s Captain takes on the Cruise Director in a hilarious cooking competition, with guests even getting the chance to sample the food.

The evening continues with a drawing session with legendary Disney artist Don “Ducky” Williams, the Crew Talent Show in the Walt Disney Theatre, and a late-night magic performance from Blake Vogt.

A brilliant final sea day before reaching Disney’s private island tomorrow.

title: Our Most Magical Sea Day on a Disney Cruise!
summary:
It’s Day 12 of our Disney Fantasy Transatlantic Cruise, and this might just be the most magical sea day of the entire journey. ✨

After nearly two weeks onboard, we realise something surprising… we’ve never actually watched the ship’s morning show!

So we head to D Lounge to sit in the audience for Good Morning Disney Fantasy, where magician Blake Vogt appears to preview his show later that evening.

The day continues with our now-traditional 3.5 laps around the promenade deck, spotting characters on the grand staircase, and even watching a movie in the Buena Vista Theatre onboard the ship.

Back in our cabin we discover we’ve been Pixie Dusted, returning to find surprise gifts waiting for us — one of those small Disney Cruise Line touches that makes the experience so special.

In the evening we head to the Walt Disney Theatre to see Blake Vogt’s full magic show — one of the most impressive magicians we’ve ever seen.

Then it’s time for something we’ve never experienced before on a Disney cruise…

🎉 Mickey’s Color Spin Dance Party

This colourful deck show features Mickey, Minnie, Daisy and even Max, creating a high-energy party on the ship’s upper deck.

Finally, we head to Animator’s Palate for one of the most iconic Disney Cruise Line experiences — drawing our own characters and watching them come to life on the restaurant screens.

A truly magical sea day as our transatlantic journey gets closer to its final destination.

title: Did We Almost Lose Our Castaway Cay Stop?!
summary:
Another day at sea on our Disney Fantasy transatlantic cruise brings some of the funniest and most unexpected moments of the entire crossing.

After yesterday’s huge announcement that our itinerary had changed and we would now be visiting Disney’s Castaway Cay, the excitement across the ship was still buzzing.

But during today’s Guests vs Crew challenge, the crew jokingly claim that if the guests lose… the Castaway Cay stop might be cancelled!

Of course it’s all in good fun — but it makes for one of the most entertaining moments of the cruise.

The day continues with some classic Disney Cruise Line activities including the adorable Jack-Jack’s Incredible Diaper Dash, a fascinating Virtual Bridge Tour hosted by the ship’s First Officer, and even a windy round of mini golf at sea on Goofy’s Sports Deck.

We finish the evening with 2010s Music Trivia in The Tube before enjoying one of our favourite dinners of the entire cruise back in Royal Court.

Another relaxing sea day — and we’re getting closer to Castaway Cay.

title: Our Disney Cruise Just Changed… We’re Going to Castaway Cay!
summary:
One unexpected announcement completely changes the rest of our Disney Fantasy transatlantic cruise.

This episode begins as another relaxing sea day on the Disney Fantasy, packed with activities across the ship.

We attend a special appearance by legendary Disney artist Don “Ducky” Williams, try our hand at the Midship Detective Agency, and enjoy another day of trivia, shows, and sea-day relaxation while crossing the Atlantic.

But during an evening trivia session in The Tube, the Cruise Director interrupts with a message from the Captain…

🚨 SURPRISE ANNOUNCEMENT

Captain Wesley reveals that our itinerary has changed and we will now be visiting Disney’s Castaway Cay before arriving in Florida!

The reaction across the ship is incredible, with cheers echoing through the lounges as guests realise we’re getting an extra stop at Disney’s private island.

title: What a Sea Day on a Disney Cruise Is Really Like
summary:
What is a sea day on a Disney Cruise really like?

In this episode of our Disney Fantasy transatlantic cruise, we spend a full day at sea enjoying the relaxed rhythm of life onboard while crossing the Atlantic Ocean.

Sea days are one of the best parts of cruising, and this one is packed with activities across the ship. We take part in a daily scavenger hunt, enjoy some trivia in the lounges, and explore the beautiful art and design of the Disney Fantasy.

Of course, there’s plenty of food along the way — including some incredible Churro Mickey waffles — plus our daily promenade deck walk around the ship.

In the evening we head to the Walt Disney Theatre to watch violinist Katerina Rossa, before ending the night with dinner at Animator’s Palette.

One of the most memorable moments of the evening comes when we watch the Disney Destiny christening ceremony live on the Funnel Vision screen, while sailing in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean.

title: Disney Cruise Pirate Night… With Fireworks in the Middle of the Ocean
summary:
It’s Pirate Night on our Disney Fantasy transatlantic cruise — and that means costumes, trivia, themed dinner, and one unforgettable tradition…

🎆 Fireworks in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean.

Pirate Day at Sea is one of the most famous traditions on Disney Cruise Line, and this time we experience it while crossing the Atlantic Ocean.

We start the day with breakfast at Cabanas, before taking part in Disney Villains trivia and enjoying a relaxing sea day on deck. Later we try Disney Cruise Line bingo for the first time, with mixed success!

As evening arrives, it’s time to put on our pirate costumes and join the festivities around the ship. After pirate-themed dinner at Royal Court, we head up to the deck for the Pirate Night show — followed by the highlight of the evening…

title: We Fell in Love with Madeira | Our Disney Cruise Stop in Funchal
summary:
Our Disney Fantasy transatlantic cruise finally brings us to our first major stop: Funchal, Madeira — and it quickly becomes one of our favourite places of the entire journey.

We wake up just as the sun rises over Madeira, revealing incredible views as the Disney Fantasy docks in Funchal harbour.

After heading ashore with our friend Justin, we take the Funchal cable car high above the city to explore the peaceful village of Monte, visiting the beautiful Sanctuary of Our Lady of Monte and watching the famous Madeira toboggans rushing down the hill.

Later we wander along the Funchal promenade, take in incredible views of the Disney Fantasy from the harbour wall, and enjoy a relaxing afternoon back onboard the ship.

Back on the Disney Fantasy, Chris gives a tour of our Deluxe Oceanview Stateroom with Verandah, and we even spot an unexpected wedding taking place right outside our balcony.

As evening arrives, we experience one of the most beautiful sail-aways of the entire cruise, with the lights of Madeira slowly appearing across the island as the Disney Fantasy departs.

title: My First Proper Meal After Being Sick on Our Disney Cruise
summary:
After several difficult days at sea, things finally start to improve on our Disney Fantasy transatlantic cruise.

After several days of illness and rough seas in the Bay of Biscay, James is finally feeling well enough to leave the cabin and enjoy a proper evening onboard.

This episode takes place during a relaxing sea day aboard the Disney Fantasy as we sail toward Funchal, Madeira. It’s also formal night, giving us the chance to get dressed up and enjoy one of Disney Cruise Line’s signature evenings at sea.

Most importantly, this marks James’ first proper meal in three days as we finally make it to dinner at Animator’s Palate with our wonderful serving team.

Later in the evening we enjoy live music around the ship before heading to The Tube, the adult-only entertainment venue onboard the Disney Fantasy.

title: Our Disney Transatlantic Cruise Took an Unexpected Turn…
summary:
Our Disney transatlantic cruise aboard the Disney Fantasy takes an unexpected turn as we encounter rough seas in the Bay of Biscay and an unplanned extended stay in La Coruña, Spain.

In this episode of our Disney Cruise Line transatlantic adventure, the ocean becomes much rougher than expected. James is dealing with a painful cracked tooth and infection, meaning much of the early part of the voyage is spent resting and visiting the ship’s medical centre.

When the Disney Fantasy finally arrives in La Coruña, we head ashore to visit the famous Tower of Hercules, the world’s oldest working Roman lighthouse. But worsening weather conditions mean our next planned stop in Vigo is cancelled, leaving the ship docked in Spain for an unexpected extra night.

Back onboard, we enjoy the fantastic “Just John & Paul” Beatles tribute in the Walt Disney Theatre before preparing to head back out into the Atlantic.

This is Episode 2 of our Disney Fantasy Transatlantic Cruise series sailing from Southampton to Florida.

title: Taking a Transatlantic Disney Cruise… Was It a Mistake?
summary:
We’re taking our first ever transatlantic Disney cruise aboard the Disney Fantasy… but was this a mistake? 🚢

Join us as we begin a 12-night crossing of the Atlantic Ocean, sailing from Southampton to Florida after the ship’s recent dry dock. This is the start of our Disney Cruise Line adventure and we had no idea what to expect from nearly two weeks at sea.

📺 Watch the full Disney Fantasy Transatlantic Cruise series:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAyjagoFx90m4oewyvYKJGl4q6JjoJgQg

In this first episode, we arrive in Southampton, watch the Disney Fantasy sail into port, and begin embarkation day. Once onboard, we explore the ship, discover our stateroom, experience the Sailing Away party, and enjoy our first dinner at Royal Court before heading into the Bay of Biscay.

This is Episode 1 of our 12-part Disney Fantasy Transatlantic Cruise series documenting our journey from Southampton to Florida with stops in Europe, Madeira and the Caribbean.

title: We Flew Upper Class to New York Then This Happened 😳
summary:
After finishing work, we kick off our New York trip with an overnight stay at the Moxy Heathrow before flying to NYC with Virgin Atlantic Upper Class ✈️

From the incredible Upper Class Wing and Clubhouse at Heathrow to landing in New York and navigating our way into Manhattan, this was meant to be a smooth start… but things don’t quite go to plan 😅

We check into the Virgin Hotels New York, explore Times Square, and end the day with a last-minute Broadway show booking — Death Becomes Her 🎭

This is the first episode of our New York series — and it’s already chaos…

title: We Walked 32,000 Steps in NYC… in ONE Day 😳
summary:
After arriving in New York, it’s time for a full-on tourist day… and we definitely didn’t hold back 😅

What started as a simple breakfast quickly turned into an $80 feast at Juniors, before we set off to explore some of the most iconic sights in NYC — and somehow ended up walking over 32,000 steps in a single day 👀

From the Intrepid Air & Space Museum to the Empire State Building at night, this day had a bit of everything…

title: NYC Snowstorm CHAOS! ❄️ Flight Cancelled & Plans Ruined… (Roosevelt Island Tram)
summary:
We thought this would be a simple day exploring New York… but everything changed ❄️

We start the day walking up 5th Avenue, visiting the stunning Grand Central Terminal, before heading over to the Roosevelt Island Tram — one of the most unique (and surprisingly cheap!) ways to see New York from above.

As the snow begins to fall, we explore Roosevelt Island before heading back into Manhattan, passing iconic sights like Rockefeller Center, Radio City Music Hall and Bryant Park.

But then… things take a turn.

Our Broadway show gets cancelled.
The snowstorm intensifies.
And then we receive the email we didn’t want… our flight home is CANCELLED.

With our trip unexpectedly extended by 48 hours, we scramble to figure out accommodation (after being quoted $1000 for 2 nights 😳), before heading to see The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee at New World Stages.

We end the day with a snowy Times Square, a Target essentials run, and a full hotel room tour.

This is where the trip really starts to change…

title: We Got Kicked Out… Then This Happened in NYC ❄️
summary:
We got stuck in New York… and then got KICKED OUT of our hotel 😳❄️

After our flight was cancelled due to the snowstorm, it was time to check out of Virgin Hotels New York City and make the long, snowy trek to our new hotel — SpringHill Suites by Marriott New York Manhattan/Times Square South.

What should have been a 20-minute walk turned into a 45-minute struggle through deep snow and ice 🥶

But it wasn’t all bad…

We met up with friends in Central Park for sledging (yes, really 😅), before heading back to Times Square to try Raising Cane’s Chicken Fingers for the first time!

👉 This trip did NOT go to plan… but it made for an unforgettable adventure.

title: We Walked 5 Miles Across NYC… Then Saw THIS Show 🌆❄️
summary:
n Episode 5 of our New York adventure, we finally get a “normal” tourist day… after the chaos of the snowstorm ❄️

After replacing our completely ruined shoes 👟, we set off on a 5-mile walk across NYC — from cookies at Schmackary’s to the iconic Ghostbusters firehouse (a must-do for Chris 👻🚒), all the way to the Brooklyn Bridge and beyond.

Along the way:

* We discover the High Line is still closed due to the snow 😅
* Battle through deep snow (which James finds far too funny)
* Visit the 9/11 Memorial in a completely different atmosphere
* Walk the Brooklyn Bridge for the first time
* Take in incredible views from Brooklyn Bridge Park

And to finish the day…
🎭 We head Off-Broadway to see Little Shop of Horrors at the Westside Theatre, starring Joy Woods, Joshua Bassett & Andrew Durand — with a full review!

This ended up being one of our favourite days of the trip.

title: Flying Virgin Atlantic Upper Class Home ✈️
summary:
Our snowy New York adventure comes to an end… and we’re flying home in Virgin Atlantic Upper Class ✈️🇺🇸

After one last morning in NYC (and a final Schmackary’s cookie run 🍪), we begin our journey back to JFK — retracing our route on the subway and AirTrain.

At the airport, we check in via the Delta One entrance before heading through security and into the incredible Virgin Atlantic Clubhouse — Chris’ first time experiencing it!

From great food and drinks to one last bit of relaxation, it’s the perfect way to end the trip before boarding our Upper Class flight home on “Eliza Doolittle”.

We wrap things up back in London at the Virgin Atlantic Revivals Lounge… and reflect on an unforgettable snowy trip to New York ❄️

title: Flying to Italy for a Family Wedding 🇮🇹💍
summary:
We’re heading to Italy for a very special occasion… a family wedding! 🇮🇹💍

In Part 1 of our Italian Wedding mini-series, we travel from London Heathrow to Pisa, pick up a rental car and begin our journey into the beautiful Italian countryside.

Along the way we:
✈️ Fly British Airways Club Europe from Heathrow to Pisa
🚗 Experience Chris’ first time driving in Italy
🏡 Stay in our first ever apartment rental
🌅 Explore beautiful Passignano sul Trasimeno
🥂 Visit the stunning Villa San Crispolto wedding venue
❤️ Celebrate the marriage of Mr & Mrs Mills

This trip is all about family, gorgeous scenery and one incredible wedding venue overlooking the Umbrian countryside.

title: We FINALLY Saw the Leaning Tower of Pisa 🇮🇹
summary:
After an unforgettable family wedding in the heart of Italy, it’s time to begin our journey back to Pisa.

Before heading home, we’re determined to finally visit one of the most famous landmarks in the world – the Leaning Tower of Pisa!

Along the way we:🚗 Take one last drive through the beautiful Italian countryside🏡 Give you a final tour of our apartment overlooking Lake Trasimeno⛰️ Attempt to visit Cortona (and fail to find parking!)🍦 Stop in stunning Lucca for some incredible Italian gelato📸 Visit the iconic Leaning Tower of Pisa for the very first time✈️ Fly home in British Airways Club Europe🥂 Visit the airport lounge at Pisa Airport

From rolling hills and picturesque villages to one of Italy’s most famous attractions, this was the perfect ending to our Italian adventure.

title: Our PERFECT Ending to Virgin Voyages! 🥂 | Ibiza, Pink Agave & Flying Club Europe
summary:
Welcome to Episode 6 of our Virgin Voyages Valiant Lady cruise series!

After an incredible week sailing the Mediterranean, it’s time to enjoy our final days onboard before heading home.

We begin with a relaxed morning at sea before experiencing the resident magician at The Manor, followed by another unforgettable evening featuring dinner at Test Kitchen, a walk through Ibiza after dark, and incredible views of Valiant Lady lit up in port.

The next day we spend a little more time exploring beautiful Ibiza before one final Rockstar Happy Hour at Richard’s Rooftop, dinner at Pink Agave and another visit to the wonderfully bizarre Untitled Dance Show Party Thing.

Before leaving the ship we each take $20 into the casino to see if the Little Shop of Horrors slot machines can make us rich…

Finally it’s time to say goodbye to Valiant Lady as we travel home to the UK in British Airways Club Europe and look back on an unforgettable holiday.

title: Virgin Voyages’ Scarlet Night Lived Up to the Hype! 🔴
summary:
Today is one of the most anticipated days of our Virgin Voyages cruise... Scarlet Night! 🔴

Before the celebrations begin, we arrive in beautiful Cannes, France, where we take the tender ashore and hop aboard Le Petit Train for a tour around the city. After exploring the streets of Cannes (and surviving a very bumpy tender ride back!), we head onboard for lunch, our first visit to the hot tubs and, of course, our daily champagne at Richard's Rooftop.

As evening falls, it's finally time for Scarlet Night. We enjoy dinner at The Wake before experiencing the incredible entertainment that makes Scarlet Night one of Virgin Voyages' signature events. From Paint It Red to the unforgettable pool party, it's a night we'll never forget!

title: We Tried Virgin Voyages’ NEW Restaurant… WOW! 🤩
summary:
Day 4 aboard Virgin Voyages' Valiant Lady!

Today we arrive in La Spezia, Italy, where we take a short walk around the port and enjoy a cheeky Aperol Spritz before heading back onboard.

The afternoon is all about relaxing, editing and preparing for another fantastic evening at sea. We return to Richard's Rooftop for Happy Hour before trying Ariya, the brand-new restaurant onboard Valiant Lady... and it definitely didn't disappoint!

We then head to The Manor for the hilarious Pay Attention game show before ending the evening with another incredible performance from The Magnets in The Red Room (including a certain Celine Dion classic that made James very happy!).

Next time... we're in Cannes for the unforgettable Scarlet Night!

title: Our BIGGEST Summer Yet… Cruises, Disney & Theme Parks! ☀️✈️
summary:
After our snowy New York adventure and mini Pisa series… it’s finally time to reveal our HUGE Summer 2026 plans 👀☀️

From cruises and Disney parks to Europe’s best theme parks and some very special family trips… this summer is going to be BUSY 😅

In this video we reveal:
✈️ A Virgin Voyage with family
🏡 Center Parcs Elveden with our new baby niece
🚢 Boarding the BRAND NEW Legend of the Seas on only its second ever public sailing
🎢 Europa-Park with Matt & Devon
🇳🇴 Our first ever P&O cruise to Norway aboard Iona with James' family
🏰 Disneyland Paris + time in Paris with family
🌴 Disneyland California & Knott’s Berry Farm using our DVC points for the very first time
🎃 Orlando with Tiff — including Disney, Universal, Halloween Horror Nights RIP Tour & more DVC stays!

And remember… these trips won’t necessarily appear on YouTube in the order we actually take them 👀

We genuinely can’t wait to share all of these adventures with you ❤️

title: Our Virgin Voyages Holiday Begins! ✈️ Barcelona, Sagrada Família & a RockStar Upgrade! ⭐
summary: The first part of our Virgin Voyages holiday adventure! In this video, we explore the beautiful city of Barcelona, visit the iconic Sagrada Família, and enjoy a RockStar upgrade on our cruise. Join us as we embark on an unforgettable journey filled with excitement and luxury.

title: Our PERFECT Sea Day on Virgin Voyages!
summary: The second part of our Virgin Voyages holiday adventure! In this video, we enjoy a perfect day at sea, exploring the amenities and activities on our cruise. Join us as we relax and have a wonderful time on the Valiant Lady.

title: Rockstar Perks & The BEST Food Onboard?
summary: The third part of our Virgin Voyages holiday adventure! In this video, we explore the amazing amenities and delicious food available on our cruise. Join us as we indulge in the ultimate onboard experience on the Valiant Lady.
